data.body: Baseline and contract-card freeze on origin/main 95f97cbeb6, CI-matched extras installed. Three focused runs: 56.82s, 55.72s, 56.22s; median 56.22s, all 26 tests passed. Family medians: reviewbot ensure two calls ~15.08s plus fixture setup, lock retry family ~17s, shutdown/shared-budget pair 9.14s, autodeploy bound-reset/unreachable pair ~13.07s. Contract cards: lock—real separate holder process and dual-window flock/mkdir; holder outlives one pass; retry succeeds without replay, exhaustion emits per-pass warnings/cumulative wait, retries=0 remains exact negative control. Shutdown—real lifespan/reconcile thread path; queue review consumes most of one test-owned drain budget, reconciler receives only remainder; no-review slow fetch bypasses drain; votes/completion, timeout handed to asyncio.wait, and empty drain calls are exact postconditions. Autodeploy—real bash entrypoint and process stubs; first busy tick opens one episode, aged episode remains bound across target changes; unreachable old bot is fail-open and replacement proceeds; interrupt/defer markers and compose actions are exact postconditions. Ensure-ticket profile has no clock/window seam: its cost is real clone/fetch/reconvergence/ensure/write durability, so it is retained unchanged rather than weakening that integration contract. All tests are gating default-tier nodes under the CI pytest command.
